question: How did each salesperson's annual total sales compare to their annual sales quota? Provide the difference between their total sales and the quota for each year, organized by salesperson and year.
sql:
WITH annual_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        TRY_CAST(salespersonid AS INTEGER) as businessentityid,
        CAST(SUBSTR(orderdate::TEXT, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) as year,
        SUM(TRY_CAST(totaldue AS DOUBLE)) as annual_sales
    FROM salesorderheader
    WHERE salespersonid IS NOT NULL AND salespersonid != ''
    GROUP BY TRY_CAST(salespersonid AS INTEGER), CAST(SUBSTR(orderdate::TEXT, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)
),
annual_quota AS (
    SELECT 
        TRY_CAST(BusinessEntityID AS INTEGER) as businessentityid,
        CAST(SUBSTR(QuotaDate, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) as year,
        TRY_CAST(SUM(TRY_CAST(SalesQuota AS DOUBLE)) AS DOUBLE) as annual_quota
    FROM SalesPersonQuotaHistory
    GROUP BY TRY_CAST(BusinessEntityID AS INTEGER), CAST(SUBSTR(QuotaDate, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)
),
combined AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(s.businessentityid, q.businessentityid) as businessentityid,
        COALESCE(s.year, q.year) as year,
        COALESCE(s.annual_sales, 0) as annual_sales,
        COALESCE(q.annual_quota, 0) as annual_quota,
        COALESCE(s.annual_sales, 0) - COALESCE(q.annual_quota, 0) as difference
    FROM annual_sales s
    FULL OUTER JOIN annual_quota q ON s.businessentityid = q.businessentityid AND s.year = q.year
)
SELECT 
    businessentityid,
    year,
    ROUND(annual_sales, 2) as annual_sales,
    ROUND(annual_quota, 2) as annual_quota,
    ROUND(difference, 2) as difference
FROM combined
ORDER BY businessentityid, year;
